name: mavenLoad
description: Downloads JAR files from Maven, including their dependencies, and loads them into Lucee. Returns an array of the loaded files.

params.name: input
params.description: A struct, or an array of structs, with the Maven `groupId`, `artifactId` and `version`.

params.name: includeOptional
params.description: When true, optional dependencies are loaded too. Lucee 7+.
